meta.purpose: The Guneku Business Directory — businesses, practices and ventures run by sons and daughters of Guneku, at home and abroad. Curated records live here, in git, changed by a person in a commit. What a verified Gunekuan registers about their own business lives in Neon and is theirs to edit; the directory renders both.
meta.publication_rule: A business record publishes what belongs to the BUSINESS: its name, what it does, its public address, its own website and its own public business channels. It never publishes a person's private telephone, private email, home address or personal social account, and it never copies contact details out of somebody's Guneku profile. A business telephone or email appears only where the owner has elected to publish it.
meta.address_rule: A business may publish a street and a town, because that address is the business's own and is already public. The Indigenes register publishes a country against a person and never a town (ADR-082). Nothing here is ever read back as somebody's residence.
meta.relationship_rule: A person is attached to a business only where somebody established the relationship, and with the word the evidence supports — owner, founder, managing director, operator, physician. Where the Fondom has confirmed a business but the person is not in the Indigenes register, the relationship is HELD: the name is recorded, no slug is invented, and the page says the connection is not yet confirmed. A shared surname establishes nothing.
meta.image_rule: Logos and covers are published only where the business supplied them or they are the business's own material. Nothing is scraped to fill a card — a business with no image gets a designed placeholder, which is the honest state and is meant to look deliberate.

retired.name: Local pork supply, Guneku
retired.reason: Carried in the held business-directory record as a service offer with no business name, no proprietor and no premises — a classified advertisement rather than a business. Retired rather than migrated. The community's own caution given in the same thread, that meat should be inspected by an authorised veterinarian before sale, is recorded here so it is not lost with it.

It is the studio behind the Guneku Fondom's own digital platform — this website — which makes it the rare case of a Guneku business whose work the village can simply look at.

businesses.sourceNote: Assembled from the profile this site already publishes. No client, contract or result is claimed here that the record does not establish.

businesses.name: Midas Property Auctions
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial property auctions, London and the South East.
businesses.description: A London property auction business handling residential and commercial lots, working across London, Essex and the wider United Kingdom. It runs auctions in the formats the modern market uses — in the room, online and timed.

people.evidence: Confirmed by the Fondom on 16 September 2026. The legacy Sons and Daughters listing already recorded him as a property auction specialist in the United Kingdom.

businesses.sourceNote: Midas Property Auctions and Midas Property Group appear as related public surfaces of the same operation, so one record is kept and the second name is carried as a spelling. No corporate structure, holding relationship or company registration is asserted, because none is established here. No website is published: none was established, and one has not been invented.

businesses.name: Fondom Studios
businesses.tagline: Film, photography and design, telling Guneku's story from Guneku.

It is media partner to both MEFU and MECUDA, and is described as one of the first legally registered media companies in Momo Division.

people.evidence: Confirmed by the Fondom on 16 September 2026, and reconciled to his register entry on 17 September.

businesses.sourceNote: The business itself is already established in this repository's institution record. Two locations are given by the sources: a street address at Tanwi Street, Windig Square, in Guneku, and a separate public listing describing the studio as being in Bamenda. The conflict is NOT resolved here — the Fondom's own record places the studio in Guneku, so Guneku is what this record carries, and the Bamenda listing is noted rather than chosen between. No website is published: none was established. The studio's own Facebook page is a public business channel and is published; no personal number was taken from any source.

businesses.name: Concept Care Solutions
businesses.tagline: Home care and healthcare recruitment across the South East of England.
businesses.description: A United Kingdom home-care provider and healthcare recruitment business, delivering care in people's own homes and placing nursing and care staff. It has operated for more than twenty years and works across several English counties, with activity announced in Northern Ireland.

people.evidence: Confirmed by the Fondom on 17 September 2026, and the public company record describes her as Managing Director. That is the title recorded here rather than a form of ownership no source states.

businesses.sourceNote: No regulator rating, inspection outcome or accreditation is published here: none was verified against an authoritative source, and a care business is the last place to repeat one that was not. No review or testimonial is carried. Services and areas are as the business's own public material describes them.

businesses.name: Urologie Neuwied
businesses.description: A urological practice in Neuwied, Germany. His Royal Highness Dr. Fomuki Walters Ticha IX, Fon of Guneku, practises here as a urologist — the Fondom's own record of him carries the practice as his current work.

people.evidence: This repository's own profile of the reigning Fon records his current work as "Urologist — Private Practice" at a Praxis für Urologie in Germany, with this website.

businesses.sourceNote: He is recorded as a physician of the practice, which is what the record establishes. No ownership, partnership or shareholding is asserted: nothing held here states one, and a medical practice's ownership is not something to infer. The Fon has one identity on this site, his own Palace profile, and this business links to it rather than creating a second.

ARCpoint Labs is a national brand: nothing here says or implies that the brand itself is owned by anybody connected to Guneku, and no national or franchisor channel is published as this business’s own.
